title: FixNow information architecture audit
method: Static implementation audit after the P0/P1 completion pass, with fresh automated validation. It does not substitute for device or independent two-party runtime testing.

reconciledGaps.evidence: Human-readable status, progress guidance, created and updated timestamps, category, description, and resolution notes.
Authorized service name, issue detail, distance, request time, and pre-acceptance privacy boundary.
Availability, schedule, incoming requests, and assigned-work context are grouped together.
Status, created time, reporter-safe operational context, booking reference, evidence, and authorized next action. Assignee/escalation is not shown because the backend does not expose it.
Authorized category create, update, activation, emergency-category flag, and confirmed deletion controls.
Timestamped operational snapshot with explicit non-financial scope; no fabricated revenue, ratings, or review metrics.

notVerified.reason: A simultaneous independent-session realtime test was not captured.
Fresh provider GPS position was not observed on the authorized customer map.
Automated checks passed, but target device/browser inspection is still required.

privacy: Customer address and contact details remain hidden from providers until acceptance.
Customer tracking exposes provider location only through authorized booking tracking data.
Admin support views retain operational context but should not invent assignee/escalation data that the backend does not expose.
Analytics excludes payments, revenue, ratings, reviews, and unnecessary personal data.
nextActions: Resolve P1 approval blockers before beginning unrelated P2 work.
Capture direct two-party realtime and live-GPS evidence against a reachable backend.
Perform responsive and accessibility walkthroughs on the requested browser and device breakpoints.
